label: Occurrence roles and numerical bearer equality
term: Occurrence roles and numerical bearer equality
definition: Occurrence is a three-element occurrence-role type, not persons or bodies. A supplied bearer map into B represents numerical identity by ordinary Lean equality of its values. Distinct says the two later roles have unequal bearers. The supplied directed continuation relation is primitive and independent of equality; Sufficient makes its identity bridge explicit. It does not define memory, causal or psychological continuity, nor identify any later bodies as persons. Applying B as person bearers and continuation as an adequate psychological relation remains OPEN.
